component.name: TUF-Helper
component.summary: Control center for ASUS laptops and DDC/CI monitors

description.p: TUF-Helper is a lightweight native Linux desktop control center built with Rust and Slint for ASUS TUF and ROG laptops alongside VESA DDC/CI external monitors.

ul.li: Simultaneous internal panel (GNOME Mutter SetBacklight) and external monitor (DDC/CI VCP 0x10) brightness and refresh-rate control
External display calibration: contrast (0x12), color presets (0x14), per-channel RGB gain (0x16/0x18/0x1A), DPMS standby (0xD6), Wayland rotation, and PipeWire audio fallback

ASUS firmware tuning via asusd: power profiles, dual fan curves with rollback protection, GPU mode switching, CPU power limits, NVIDIA thermal target, Aura lighting, overdrive, and battery charge threshold
Low-overhead sysfs telemetry for CPU/GPU temperatures and fan RPMs without waking a suspended NVIDIA dGPU

screenshot.caption: Overview tab showing power profile, GPU mode, lighting, and battery charge limit
Cooling tab with live sysfs temperature, fan telemetry, and custom 8-point curves
Display tab with multi-monitor DDC/CI, auto-refresh, and overdrive controls
Battery tab in Yaru Light theme with One-Shot 100% charge and AC/Battery automation

description.p: Adds multi-monitor MCCS 0xF3 discovery, VCP 0x60 input switching and 0x86 scaling, interactive 8-point CPU/GPU fan curves, AC/battery automation, One-Shot 100% charge, reactive D-Bus signals, CLI/D-Bus shortcuts, and GNOME Yaru Light/Dark theme sync.
Initial release featuring dual-display brightness and refresh-rate control, VESA DDC/CI calibration, ASUS asusd firmware tuning, and dGPU-safe sysfs telemetry.
